item.title: Fear and loathing in Trump's Miami backyard over immigration crackdown
item.description: Staring into the camera, Rep. Maria Salazar (R-Fla.) cut a new campaign ad that told President Trump what many of her fellow Hispanic Republicans think about the immigration crackdown.

item.title: Judge warns Blanche of contempt in Epstein files case
item.description: A federal judge told Attorney General Todd Blanche on Wednesday that contempt proceedings are possible if the Justice Department does not comply.

item.title: White House withdraws ICE nominee after MAGA opposition
item.description: The White House is withdrawing Lance Schroyer's stalled nomination to lead ICE, as his limited immigration experience created tension.

item.title: Judge intervenes amid Kennedy Center demolition concerns
item.description: Trump officials must provide 30 days' written notice before any changes to the Kennedy Center, including any demolition.
